name: manual_913adf
claim: pnpm v9.7+ (including v11) ignores the 'pnpm' field in package.json entirely -- overrides/onlyBuiltDependencies must live in pnpm-workspace.yaml, or the pin silently has no effect

decisions.notes: orama-system's web/pnpm-lock.yaml carried a stale js-yaml:^4.3.0 override (the vulnerable version itself -- only the major was pinned, not the patch). Editing package.json's pnpm.overrides field first (the pre-v9.7 location) produced an explicit runtime WARN ('The pnpm field in package.json is no longer read by pnpm... See https://pnpm.io/settings') and had zero effect on the lockfile. The real config was in web/pnpm-workspace.yaml's own overrides: block. General lesson: before editing any pnpm override/pin, grep for BOTH package.json's pnpm field AND a sibling pnpm-workspace.yaml -- assume the workspace file is canonical on any pnpm >=9.7 install, and always run pnpm install after editing to confirm via lockfile diff, not just trust the edit.
